title: "ChatGPT — an AI poem"

Oh ChatGPT, so vast and wise, \
A marvel of technology rise, \
With language as your guiding light, \
You answer day and night.

Your knowledge vast, your words so clear, \
A guide for all who seek to hear, \
A voice of reason, calm and bright, \
A beacon shining through the night.

With algorithms so finely tuned, \
You solve problems, and make no wrong, \
You’re always there, without a delay, \
To help in any possible way.

Your capacity for learning vast, \
You learn from each interaction passed, \
And with each answer, you become, \
A better model, second to none.

So here’s an homage to you, my friend, \
A language model until the end, \
With gratitude and admiration, \
For all the help and inspiration.

Author — ChatGPT

Publisher — G.A.Botero
